$comment: Mutation arms cutting the types of package anyparse.grammar.haxe.cond. Format and rules: docs/testing.md, Declared arms.

arms.name: M-COND-BLOCK-TAIL-NEVER
arms.note: the block-tail terminal never matches, so a `#if` region that closes its enclosing block and opens one of its own falls back to CondSpliceStmt and the whole region is raw bytes again

arms.name: M-COND-PARAM-ELSE-PLAIN
arms.note: the `#else` arm of a parameter region captures no per-element separator, so the comma it writes before `#end` is lost and that arm compiles two parameters with nothing between them

arms.name: M-COND-PARAM-ELSEIF-PLAIN
arms.note: an `#elseif` arm of a parameter region captures no per-element separator, so the comma it writes before the next directive is lost

arms.name: M-SEMI-ELSEIF-PER-LINE
arms.note: a value region's #elseif body takes one element per line, so it breaks between inline #if and #else branches

arms.name: M-COND-OPERAND-PAREN-GROUP
arms.note: a parenthesised condition is no operand, so the generated splice predicate stops before the infix operator after the group and the region skip-parses

arms.name: M-COND-GROUP-STOPS-AT-LINE
arms.note: a parenthesised group runs only to the end of its line, so `#if (` / `sys` / `)` on three lines is no condition

arms.name: M-COND-OPERATOR-OPERAND-SAME-LINE
arms.note: a `&&` after a flag and the flag after it, on this line or the next, join the condition, so `lime && x` reads as one condition instead of `lime` with the operator opening the body

arms.name: M-COND-NEGATION-OPERAND-SAME-LINE
arms.note: the operand of a `!` must sit on its line, so `!` / `sys` on two lines is no condition

arms.name: M-COND-GROUP-DEPTH-CAP
arms.note: a group nested inside a group is no piece of it, so the condition terminal rejects a nested `#if` group the way a depth-capped regex did

arms.name: M-COND-GROUP-QUOTE-BLIND
arms.note: a group's text runs over a quote, so a quoted `)` inside a group closes it, the condition terminal stops inside the string and the region no longer parses

arms.name: M-COND-GROUP-COMMENT-BLIND
arms.note: a block comment inside a group is read as condition text, so its quote opens a string or its paren closes the group and the region no longer parses

arms.name: M-COND-NUMBER-DOTTED
arms.note: a numeric operand stops at its dot, so `#if 4.2` reads `4` and leaves `.2` to the region body

arms.name: M-COND-QUOTED-OPERAND
arms.note: a quoted string is no condition operand, so a quoted `#if` condition carries no condition at all

arms.name: M-COND-QUOTED-ESCAPE-OFF
arms.note: a backslash no longer hides the character after it, so an escaped quote ends a condition literal early

arms.name: M-COND-QUOTED-UNTERMINATED
arms.note: a literal with no closing quote is read as closed, so the rest of an unterminated condition is read as a value

arms.name: M-COND-FLAG-DOTTED
arms.note: a flag stops at its first dot, so `a.b` reads `a` and leaves `.b` as trailing text

arms.name: M-CONDVALUE-AND-LOOSE
arms.note: `&&` binds like `||`, so `a || b && c` groups left to right

arms.name: M-CONDVALUE-CMP-LOOSE
arms.note: `==` binds looser than `||`, so `a == b || c` compares `a` with the whole disjunction

arms.name: M-CONDVALUE-CMP-RIGHT
arms.note: `==` groups to the right, so a chain of comparisons nests the other way

arms.name: M-CONDVALUE-NOT-GONE
arms.note: `!` is no prefix operator of a condition

arms.name: M-CONDVALUE-GTEQ-SHADOWED
arms.note: `>=` is never matched, so `a >= b` reads `a > ` and fails on the `=`

arms.name: M-CONDVALUE-VERSION-FLAG
arms.note: `version(` is not a call of its own, so it reads as the flag `version` followed by trailing text

arms.name: M-CONDVALUE-GROUP-BRACKET
arms.note: a group is written in brackets, so a parenthesised condition is no operand

arms.name: M-COND-VALUE-SCHEMA-LINE-COMMENT
arms.note: a condition is read with the Haxe whitespace, so a `//` comment is a blank where the compiler refuses it

arms.name: M-COND-VALUE-CHAIN
arms.note: a comparison of a comparison is evaluated, so `a == b == c` is decided where the compiler has no such condition

arms.name: M-COND-VALUE-GROUP
arms.note: a parenthesised condition reads as a flag no define set names, so it is never decided

arms.name: M-COND-VALUE-VERSION
arms.note: a quoted literal keeps its quotes, so no `version("…")` names a version
